cards.existing: wedi + verbnoun = perfect tense. Dw i wedi bwyta (I have eaten). Replaces 'n from the present pattern.

cards.target: Dw i'n gwrando ar gerddoriaeth ar y ffordd i'r gwaith.
cards.english: I listen to music on the way to work.

cards.target: Dw i'n mynd ar y fferi o Gaergybi i Ddulyn.
cards.english: I'm going on the ferry from Holyhead to Dublin.

cards.target: Mae coginio prydau iach i'r teulu yn rhywbeth rwy'n mwynhau ei wneud bob nos.
cards.english: Cooking healthy meals for the family is something I enjoy doing every evening.

cards.target: Esgusodwch fi.
cards.english: Excuse me.

cards.target: Dych chi'n siarad Saesneg?
cards.english: Do you speak English?

cards.target: Ble mae'r toiled?
cards.english: Where is the toilet?

cards.target: Faint mae hyn yn gostio?
cards.english: How much does this cost?

cards.target: Dŵr, os gwelwch yn dda.
cards.english: Water, please.

cards.target: Y bil, os gwelwch yn dda.
cards.english: The bill, please.
